## What do you need to move forward?

| Your situation | A practical next step |
|---|---|
| An agent works in demos, but you need evidence before a rollout | [Agent Reliability Audit](engage.qmd#reliability-audit): measure answer quality and identify the failures worth fixing first |
| You have a defined analytics use case and need it built | [Agent Build Sprint](engage.qmd#build-sprint): one workflow, an agreed acceptance test, and a working implementation |
| Your agent is in use and changes keep introducing uncertainty | [Reliability Retainer](engage.qmd#reliability-retainer): regression checks and reviews as the system evolves |
| You need engineering delivery or technical leadership inside your team | [Embedded AI Engineering](engage.qmd#embedded-engineering): hands-on delivery under your planning |

## Start with a clear picture of reliability

The **Agent Reliability Audit** is a focused, fixed-price engagement, typically about two weeks once access and scope are agreed. It gives your team:

- An evaluation suite built from representative questions and expected results.
- A baseline showing where the agent succeeds, fails, or needs human review.
- A ranked set of fixes, with the evidence behind each recommendation.

You keep the suite and report. Use them to decide what to fix, what to test further, and whether to proceed with a build or rollout.

[See the audit scope and deliverables](engage.qmd#reliability-audit){.btn .btn-primary}
